one_line: DeepSeek secures $15 billion, Europe embraces NVIDIA models, AI finds PHP bugs, Microsoft hits 83% diagnostic accuracy.

themes.title: DeepSeek raises $15 billion after US restrictions
themes.text: DeepSeek, a Chinese AI startup, secured roughly 100 billion yuan ($15 billion) from investors including CATL and Tencent, two days after the U.S. ordered federal agencies to remove its technology from their systems.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions

themes.title: NVIDIA open models spread across Europe
themes.text: European government projects, climate forecasting, retail services, and finance firms are integrating NVIDIA’s open‑weight AI models and hardware, including DGX BasePOD and Triton, to improve public services, weather predictions, inference costs, and in‑house intelligence. The Polarise AI Cloud was also launched as a sovereign European AI platform at NVIDIA’s GTC Berlin.

stories.headline: NVIDIA open models adopted in European public sector projects
European firms adopt NVIDIA Earth‑2 models for weather and climate forecasting
European retailers cut inference costs up to 90% using NVIDIA open models
European banks and fintechs adopt NVIDIA open‑weight models for proprietary AI
Polarise launches sovereign AI cloud at NVIDIA GTC Berlin

themes.title: AI tools uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities
themes.text: AI models from OpenAI and Google’s Wiz identified two critical memory‑safety bugs (CVE‑2026‑109618 and CVE‑2026‑109619) in PHP, a language powering roughly 70% of websites; patches were released on October 21.

stories.headline: AI tools uncover critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting up to 70% of websites

themes.title: Microsoft diagnostic system reaches 83% accuracy
themes.text: Microsoft’s Diagnostic Orchestrator (MAI‑DxO) correctly diagnosed complex medical cases 83% of the time in simulations, outperforming generalist physicians who achieved 36% on the same tasks and 80% versus 47% on emergency department cases.

stories.headline: Microsoft AI diagnostic system hits 83% accuracy, over twice doctors in complex cases
